scientific.integrity: The claim is derived from the exact multiplicative form of the SARAH recursive direction on a two-curvature scalar quadratic family. The limiting iterate is an explicitly summable random perpetuity; its first two moments and the dyadic uniform special case are proved analytically.
limitations: Only a single indefinitely long inner loop is analyzed; standard SARAH periodically restarts with a full gradient.
The two component quadratics share the same minimizer.
The exact uniform limiting law is a special parameter slice; general heterogeneity gives other Bernoulli-convolution laws.
The result does not optimize finite computational budgets or outer-loop schedules.

title: Exact random residual floor for a single infinite SARAH inner loop
